question: At least one of {GEICO/Berkshire, Progressive, State Farm, Allstate, Liberty Mutual} reports Q2 2026 paid-marketing-spend up >=15% year-over-year in Q2 2026 earnings disclosures. P=0.72.
resolution_criterion: Q2 2026 earnings filings (10-Q) or earnings call transcripts from any of the five named carriers cite Q2 2026 advertising/marketing spend up >=15% vs Q2 2025. Resolves at the latest Q2 release among the five (typically late July / early August 2026).
